sanskrit_verse:
एषा हि स्वामिभृत्यानां वै क्रिया परिकीर्तिता ।
संविद्विधानम् अधुना समासेन निबोधत ॥ १७.१
transliteration: eṣā hi svāmibhṛtyānāṃ vai kriyā parikīrtitā | saṃvidvidhānam adhunā samāsena nibodhata || 17.1
sph_interpretive_translation: This indeed is the declared action between master and servant; now understand the arrangement of mutual consent in summary.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority arises from clarity of role and mutual recognition.
Causation flows from conscious agreement, not coercion.
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by awareness and acceptance.
Restoration occurs through re-establishing rightful relational order.
Consciousness alignment is achieved when roles are voluntarily upheld.
executable_legal_axioms: IF a relationship involves master-servant dynamics, THEN it must be founded on explicit mutual consent.
IF consent is absent or unclear, THEN no enforceable duty exists.
IF deviation occurs, THEN restoration proceeds via reaffirmation of original agreement.
IF capacity to consent is impaired, THEN intervention restores autonomy before obligations are confirmed.
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating disputes involving hierarchical relationships, the Supreme Court must first establish whether mutual consent was clearly given. Absent such clarity, all claimed duties are null. The threshold for responsibility lies exclusively in verified conscious agreement.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa is based on verifiable consent. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests as breakdown in communication leading to misalignment. Proportional responsibility correlates with degree of conscious participation. Non-punitive reality is upheld as truth reorients parties back to original harmony without infliction of harm.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Reaffirmation Protocol: Parties engage in structured dialogue to restore mutual understanding.
Volition Verification Process: Ensures that all agreements stem from uncoerced awareness.
Relational Realignment Procedure: Reconstructs roles according to clarified expectations.
Autonomy Restoration Mechanism: Supports individuals in regaining decision-making capacity where compromised.
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of Law. Dharma is restored through conscious alignment. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone is the ultimate adjudicator.
